description: DEBUG-ONLY — loaded only by the Makefile `apk-dev` target, which adds it to app.security.capabilities via a `--config` override (release keeps capabilities=[default], so this rule is not even compiled into release builds). Grants the frontend dev server — loaded as a remote URL by the debug dev-shell — the same IPC the bundled app has, so the dev-server page can invoke app commands (set_api_origin, set_access_token, clear_access_token) and post notifications. remote.urls is intentionally broad (any http(s) origin) for dev convenience; never present in release.
